os-caching.title: Caching
os-caching.summary: One cache API for memory and an optional shared store such as Redis, with protection against loading the same data twice.

gives.1: Cache any value with one call: the loader runs on a miss, and callers that arrive at the same time wait for that one run.
gives.2: Start with memory only and add Redis later, without changing the code that reads the cache.
gives.3: Safe defaults: an expiration on every entry, a size limit per entry, and no size limit forced on the app's shared memory cache.

sample.quick: Cache a value for five minutes

setup.title: Setup
setup.summary: Register the cache once and choose its defaults.

1.title: Defaults
1.text: `AddOSCaching` registers Microsoft's `HybridCache` with its own defaults.

2.title: Limits
2.text: Entries live 10 minutes, up to 1 MiB, with keys up to 1024 characters.

3.title: Second level
3.text: A registered `IDistributedCache` such as Redis becomes the second level.

4.title: Shared memory cache
4.text: The app's shared `IMemoryCache` gets no size limit.

1.title: Defaults
1.text:
`AddOSCaching` registers Microsoft's `HybridCache` with these defaults: entries live for 10 minutes and one entry can be up to 1 MiB.

A key can be up to 1024 characters. Calling `AddOSCaching` again changes nothing.

2.title: Oversized values
2.text: A value over a limit is not cached, and the call still returns it.

3.title: Distributed cache
3.text:
When an `IDistributedCache` such as Redis is registered, `HybridCache` uses it as a second level behind memory, so every server sees the same data.

Without one, it caches in memory only.

4.title: Shared memory cache
4.text:
The app's shared `IMemoryCache` gets no size limit.

A limit there would break any other code that uses it without giving a size.

defaults.title: Register with the defaults
defaults.note: The values are the expiration, the payload limit in bytes and the key length limit.

configure.title: Choose your own defaults
configure.note: The memory copy expires after 5 minutes, so a server picks up a change from Redis sooner than the full hour.

type.CacheOptions: The defaults `AddOSCaching` applies. They are checked at startup, so a wrong value fails early.

CacheOptions.Expiration: How long an entry lives. The default is 10 minutes.
CacheOptions.LocalExpiration: How long the in-memory copy lives. It defaults to Expiration and can't be longer.
CacheOptions.MaxPayloadBytes: The largest value that is cached, in bytes. The default is 1 MiB.
CacheOptions.MaxKeyLength: The longest key that is cached. The default is 1024 characters.

usage.title: Using the cache
usage.summary: Read through the cache, store values, and remove them when the data changes.

2.title: Run once
2.text: On a miss the loader runs once, even for concurrent requests.

3.title: Removing
3.text: Remove a key with `RemoveAsync`, or a tagged group with `RemoveByTagAsync`.

4.title: Key shape
4.text: Build keys like `area:type:id` and add the tenant or user when needed.

1.title: Reading through the cache
1.text:
Inject `HybridCache` and call `GetOrCreateAsync` with a key, a loader and an expiration.

On a miss the loader runs once, even when many requests ask for the same key at the same time. Every caller gets its result.

2.title: Values and errors
2.text:
A cached 0, false or empty value counts as found.

Errors from the loader are not hidden; they reach the caller.

3.title: Removing entries
3.text:
When the data behind a key changes, remove the key with `RemoveAsync`.

To clear a group of entries together, give them a tag and call `RemoveByTagAsync`.

4.title: Building keys
4.text:
Build keys like `area:type:id`.

Add the tenant or user to the key whenever the value depends on who is asking.

get-or-create.title: Read through the cache
get-or-create.note: The store is called only on a miss. The token cancels the loader only when every waiting caller has cancelled.

set.title: Store a value directly
set.note: Use it when you already have fresh data, for example right after saving it.

remove.title: Remove a key after the data changes
remove.note: Save first, then remove, so the next read loads the new data.

tags.title: Clear a group of entries
tags.note: A tag removal marks older entries as stale; they are reloaded on their next read.

type.CacheEx: Registration and the `HybridCache` overloads that take the expiration as a TimeSpan.

CacheEx.GetOrCreateAsync: Returns the cached value, or runs the loader once and caches its result for the given time.
CacheEx.SetAsync: Stores a value for the given time, replacing any older one.
